newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen stocks dive on share quota, suspensions.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen stocks dive on share quota, suspensions.

text.p: The suspension of two A share companies sent Shenzhen stocks into something close to free fall on Friday, with investors dumping shares said to be next in line, analysts said.
The foreign currency B share index plunged 13.46 points or 7.80 percent to 159.07 points on turnover of HK$122.7 million, against Thursday's HK$184.3 million.
The domestic currency A index lost 48.10 points or 9.33 percent at 467.37 on turnover of 11.6 billion yuan compared with 11.4 billion on Thursday.
"People are dumping shares which have risen sharply in the past few days after the stock exchange suspended the two heavy gainers," an analyst at China Guotai Securities said.
